stopHint: Stops the work and ends the session. The bot stays available in the chat.
deleteBody: The conversation of “{{title}}” and its history leave the app. The files in the virtual machine and the branch stay there.

plan.noSteps: The bot listed no steps in this session.
plan.noStepsYet: The bot has not listed its steps yet. They show up here once it starts.

unavailable.no_baseline: Changes show up once the virtual machine is on and the session has prepared its folder.
unavailable.vm_not_running: Turn on the virtual machine to see the changes.
unavailable.too_large: This session’s folder is too large to follow its changes (over 20 thousand files or 200 MB).
unavailable.failed: Could not read the changes right now.

diff.noNewline: no newline at end of file
diff.noTextChanges: No text differences in this file.
diff.truncated: The file is too large: only the start of the differences shows here.
diff.binary: Binary file: its differences cannot be shown.
diff.loadFailed: Could not open this file’s differences.

settings.subtitle: Long work the bots do alongside the chat: follow the steps and what changed in each one.
settings.empty: No sessions yet. Bots open one when the work is large (a change across many files, for example) or when you approve a plan to run in a session.
